text.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ عَنْ أَشْيَآءَ إِن تُبْدَ لَكُمْ تَسُؤْكُمْ وَإِن تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ عَنْهَا حِينَ يُنَزَّلُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ تُبْدَ لَكُمْ عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَنْهَا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌۭ

words.gloss_range: vocative call opening the whole legal address as direct speech
words.prose: {{ar:يَٰٓ}} ({{tr:yā}}) opens the ayah as direct address before any rule is stated. The extended call makes the coming restraint face the believing community as summoned hearers, so the prohibition begins inside relationship rather than as an abstract maxim.

topics.headline: direct vocative opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the legal restraint begins as direct address to a summoned community, not as detached rule language.
topics.reason: The particle opens the address formula and scopes over the following prohibition and conditionals.

words.gloss_range: formal vocative focus that requires a following qualifier
words.prose: {{ar:أَيُّهَا}} ({{tr:ayyuhā}}) turns the raw call into a formal audience-focus. Its grammar waits for the following qualifier, so the addressees are not left undefined before the command arrives.

topics.headline: vocative focus requiring qualification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the address being built step by step before the audience is named.
topics.reason: The form requires the following relative qualifier and intensifies the public address.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun defining the addressed class by the following act of belief
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes the audience a class defined by what follows. The restraint on inquiry is therefore aimed at people already identified through belief, not at an anonymous crowd.

topics.headline: relative clause defines the audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is addressed to a belief-defined community before the prohibition begins.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun links the vocative to the qualifying verb and belongs to a recurring believer-address formula.

words.gloss_range: completed believing/trusting state that grounds the following restraint
words.root_gloss_range: root range of safety, security, trust, and being free from fear; locally selected through a Form IV believing/trusting verb
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) lands the opening on completed trust before the command not to ask. The safety-and-trust root field makes the restraint protective: uncontrolled disclosure could disturb the security named in the addressees' own identity.

topics.headline: completed belief precedes restraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prohibition presupposes an already established state of belief and trust.
topics.reason: The perfect Form IV verb qualifies the addressed group before the second-person prohibition begins.

topics.headline: trust root makes the warning protective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that restraint from inquiry protects trust rather than opposing knowledge in the abstract.
topics.reason: The root field of safety and trust coheres with the local collision of belief, questioning, and unspecified matters.

topics.headline: same audience across the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from the prior ayah into direct believer-address within the same communal thread.
topics.reason: Boundary and same-surah evidence connect the addressee chain to the surrounding legal discourse.

words.gloss_range: prohibitive particle making non-asking a command
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is prohibitive rather than merely negative. It turns not asking about the matters into a formal command and sets the baseline before the ayah explores what disclosure and revelation-time asking do.

topics.headline: formal prohibition governs asking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah commands restraint, not merely describes the absence of questions.
topics.reason: The particle governs the jussive verb and scopes over the asking-about phrase.

words.gloss_range: prohibited asking-about act aimed at unspecified matters
words.root_gloss_range: root range of asking, requesting, and seeking information; locally narrowed by the prohibited asking-about construction
words.prose: {{ar:تَسْـَٔلُوا۟}} ({{tr:tasʾalū}}) is the ordinary asking verb, but here it is held in the jussive prohibition and aimed through an about-frame at hidden matters. Its range includes seeking or demanding disclosure, which explains why a normal question-act can become dangerous in this context; even the hamza catch makes the stopped inquiry audible.

topics.headline: asking governed by prohibition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ordinary act of asking becomes a controlled act because grammar, construction, and sound all converge on restraint.
topics.reason: The verb is jussive after the prohibitive particle and takes an about-complement marking the topic of inquiry.

topics.headline: asking warning joins other passages
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this asking is not anti-inquiry in general; it belongs to a differentiated pattern where some asking is lawful and some becomes dangerous.
topics.reason: The source rows contrast this location with permitted inquiry in 5:4 and warning patterns such as 2:108 and 4:153.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the topic of inquiry rather than the addressee
words.prose: {{ar:عَنْ}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) fixes the scope of the prohibition. The asking is not a generic ban on requests; it is asking about unspecified matters, with the preposition keeping the object as subject matter under scrutiny. Its away-from pressure makes the inquiry reach toward matters held at a distance rather than already possessed knowledge.

topics.headline: preposition marks inquiry topic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prohibition targets subject-matter probing, not every request or question.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following noun and completes the asking-about construction.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural matters, broad in reference but tracked as one collective referent
words.root_gloss_range: broad root range for thinghood and conceivable entity, with a debated relation to willing; locally an indefinite plural class of matters
words.prose: {{ar:أَشْيَآءَ}} ({{tr:ashyāʾa}}) keeps the prohibited field deliberately open: unspecified things, not a named case. Its broken-plural behavior then lets the ayah track that open class as one collective referent through disclosure, further questioning, and pardon; the debated thinghood-and-willing background adds created-entity pressure without replacing the local sense of matters.

topics.headline: indefinite plural tracked as one referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah keeps the matters unspecified while still carrying the same referent through the whole sequence.
topics.reason: The indefinite plural is governed in the inquiry frame and later controlled by feminine singular agreement and pronoun continuity.

topics.headline: thinghood and willing pressure remains bounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the matters are broad conceivable entities under divine scope, while local grammar keeps them as unspecified things rather than turning the verse into a theory of willing.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is meaningful as lexical pressure, but the local noun functions as an indefinite plural object of inquiry.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle making harmful disclosure contingent
words.prose: {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}) makes the first disclosure scenario conditional. The warning is procedural: if the matters are disclosed, distress follows; it is not a claim that every hidden matter is already appearing.

topics.headline: first conditional frames possible disclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that harm is tied to a conditional disclosure sequence rather than asserted as an inevitable fact.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the first protasis and is later echoed by the second conditional.

words.gloss_range: passive conditional disclosure, with agent suppressed and exposure foregrounded
words.root_gloss_range: root range of appearing, making manifest, and spreading into visibility; locally selected as passive caused disclosure
words.prose: {{ar:تُبْدَ}} ({{tr:tubda}}) names disclosure as something made visible within the first condition. The passive hides the agent and foregrounds the matters arriving upon the audience; the root image of manifestation and spreading makes the disclosure feel like exposure rather than calm explanation. Variant pressure tests agency and agreement, while the canonical form keeps passive feminine agreement with the earlier matters.

topics.headline: agentless disclosure in the first condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices disclosure as an imposed event whose agent is not on the surface.
topics.reason: The Form IV passive jussive is governed by the conditional particle and suppresses the discloser.

topics.headline: manifestation becomes harmful exposure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb turns knowledge into exposure, a marked making-visible that can produce harm.
topics.reason: The dictionary and contextual rows link the root to manifestation, spreading, rarity, and disclosure-harm patterns.

topics.headline: variant pressure tests agency and agreement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant evidence highlights agency and agreement, while the canonical form keeps passive feminine agreement with the matters.
topics.reason: The variants are useful contrast, but the canonical local surface remains passive and agrees with the earlier matters.

words.gloss_range: dative recipient phrase where disclosure is directed to the audience without guaranteed benefit
words.prose: {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) marks the addressees as recipients of disclosure. The usual to-or-for pressure is strained by the following harm verb, so the phrase becomes disclosure directed to them and possibly against their comfort.

topics.headline: recipient phrase turns disadvantageous
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what comes to the audience may not be for their benefit.
topics.reason: The dative phrase is followed by the harm consequence and is later repeated in the second disclosure frame.

words.gloss_range: conditional distress acting directly on the addressed community
words.root_gloss_range: root range of badness, harm, ugliness, grief, and shame; locally active as distress caused to the addressed community
words.prose: {{ar:تَسُؤْكُمْ}} ({{tr:tasuʾkum}}) makes distress the result of disclosure and makes the addressed people its direct object. The harm field includes badness, grief, and shame, so the ayah presents disclosure as something that can wound morally and emotionally, not merely inform. Recitational variants can smooth the hamza surface, but they preserve the same semantic consequence of harm.

topics.headline: distress acts on the addressees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that harm is not abstract badness; it directly reaches the addressed community as the conditional result.
topics.reason: The verb functions as the apodosis, agrees with the matters, and takes the addressee suffix as object.

topics.headline: exposure becomes shame-like harm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that harmful disclosure resembles exposure of what should have remained covered, not simple disappointment.
topics.reason: The rows connect the harm root with shame, exposure, and the disclosure-harm pattern.

topics.headline: variant sound preserves the harm sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices recitational pressure at the harm verb while the semantic consequence remains stable.
topics.reason: The hamza-related variants alter surface sound but do not change the local harm meaning.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle linking two conditional scenarios for comparison
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the second conditional to the first. It makes the reader compare the two frames: disclosure leading to distress, and asking during revelation leading to disclosure. The compact return of the conditional sound gives the second frame an audible reset rather than a loose continuation.

topics.headline: two conditional scenarios are linked
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second condition is a paired counterpart to the first, not a loose afterthought.
topics.reason: The conjunction links matching conditional clauses and creates a local hinge.

words.gloss_range: second conditional particle shifting the trigger from disclosure to asking
words.prose: {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}) repeats the conditional frame but changes what is being tested. Now asking becomes the condition, and the later time phrase narrows when such asking produces disclosure.

topics.headline: asking becomes the condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a controlled exception-like scenario: the same conditional grammar returns, but the trigger and time-window change.
topics.reason: The repeated conditional particle governs the second asking clause and is narrowed by the temporal phrase.

words.gloss_range: the same asking verb reframed as a revelation-timed condition
words.root_gloss_range: root range of asking, requesting, and seeking information; locally reframed by a conditional and revelation-time limit
words.prose: {{ar:تَسْـَٔلُوا۟}} ({{tr:tasʾalū}}) returns with the same form, but its governor has changed from prohibition to condition. The repeated verb shows that the act itself is stable; frame and timing decide whether asking is forbidden, productive, or later turned into precedent in 5:102.

topics.headline: same asking form, different legal frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same act of asking changes force when moved from prohibition into a revelation-timed condition.
topics.reason: The identical imperfect form is now governed by the conditional particle and qualified by the revelation-time phrase.

topics.headline: asking links lawful inquiry and precedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this verb as a hinge between permitted inquiry, this warning, and the next ayah’s precedent (5:102).
topics.reason: The source rows connect the repeated asking root with active revelation, 5:4, and 5:102.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus feminine suffix preserving the same matters as inquiry topic
words.prose: {{ar:عَنْهَا}} ({{tr:ʿanhā}}) compresses the earlier matters into a pronoun while keeping the about-frame. The second conditional is not about a new object; it reopens the same referent under a different timing condition.

topics.headline: same matters continue in the second condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of inquiry remains the same across the prohibition and second conditional.
topics.reason: The feminine singular suffix refers back to the broken plural matters and repeats the about-construction.

words.gloss_range: temporal adverb marking a bounded active revelation window
words.prose: {{ar:حِينَ}} ({{tr:ḥīna}}) is the hinge that prevents the second condition from becoming blanket permission. It names the bounded time in which revelation is actively descending; its broader time-and-destiny pressure can color the window as limited and appointed, while local grammar selects temporal qualification.

topics.headline: time-window controls asking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that asking is constrained by a live revelation window, not opened as a timeless rule.
topics.reason: The temporal adverb qualifies the second conditional and links asking to active descent.

topics.headline: time-and-destiny pressure remains bounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a limited appointed-time pressure, while the local syntax keeps the word functioning as a temporal adverb.
topics.reason: The root pressure is meaningful but does not override the local temporal-adverb role.

words.gloss_range: ongoing passive staged sending down that defines the disclosure window
words.root_gloss_range: root range of descending, alighting, and sending down; locally selected as ongoing passive staged revelation
words.prose: {{ar:يُنَزَّلُ}} ({{tr:yunazzalu}}) makes revelation an ongoing passive process. The Form II staging, imperfect aspect, and variant contrast all make the time-window live while the revealed Recitation is being sent down, not after a completed fact; the descent image keeps revelation received rather than produced by questions.

topics.headline: ongoing staged descent defines the window
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second condition depends on active staged revelation, not a completed scripture fact.
topics.reason: The imperfect passive Form II and variant contrast support ongoing staged descent with the sender absent from the surface.

topics.headline: descent image subordinates inquiry to revelation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that questions do not generate revelation; they are subordinated to a received descent process.
topics.reason: Root image, co-occurrence, same-surah thread, and sound rows all support received staged descent.

words.gloss_range: definite revealed Recitation as the passive subject and medium of disclosure
words.root_gloss_range: root range of reciting and gathering; locally the definite revealed Recitation as passive subject of descent
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقُرْءَانُ}} ({{tr:al-qurʾānu}}) is the known revealed Recitation being sent down, not an ordinary act of reading. Its root pressure of reciting and gathering remains useful: disclosure is tied to a controlled gathered recitation, while definiteness keeps the referent fixed as the scripture-formula. Hamza and hamza-less recitational surfaces can vary the title's texture while leaving that revealed referent stable.

topics.headline: known revealed Recitation controls the window
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that disclosure is governed by the descent of the known revealed Recitation, not by private curiosity.
topics.reason: The definite noun is the passive subject of the descent verb and anchors the temporal condition.

topics.headline: reciting and gathering pressure remains local
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the scripture is both voiced and gathered, while the local clause keeps it as the specific revealed Recitation.
topics.reason: The root range is valid pressure but does not turn the local noun into a generic reading act.

topics.headline: variant and sound mark the title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recitational texture varies while the referent remains stable.
topics.reason: The hamza-related rows affect surface sound without changing the local scripture referent.

words.gloss_range: second passive disclosure, now result of revelation-timed asking
words.root_gloss_range: root range of appearing, making manifest, and spreading into visibility; locally the second passive disclosure in the paired conditionals
words.prose: {{ar:تُبْدَ}} ({{tr:tubda}}) repeats the marked disclosure verb, but its clause role changes. The first disclosure was the condition that led to distress; this second disclosure is the result of asking during active revelation, so repetition makes disclosure the ayah’s hinge.

topics.headline: same disclosure form changes clause role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same disclosure verb once as dangerous condition and once as revelation-timed result.
topics.reason: The repeated passive form is now the apodosis of the second conditional and lacks the explicit harm consequence.

topics.headline: hidden-to-visible pressure remains controlled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hidden-to-visible disclosure remains vivid, but active revelation now controls when visibility is legitimate.
topics.reason: The root pressure survives while the local revelation-time frame limits the disclosure.

words.gloss_range: repeated recipient phrase for revelation-timed disclosure
words.prose: {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) repeats the recipient phrase, keeping the same audience across both disclosure frames. The difference is not who receives disclosure but whether disclosure is tied to harm or to active revelation; the second to-or-for-you phrase is no longer followed by the explicit distress verb.

topics.headline: same audience receives both disclosures
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressees stay constant while the consequence-frame changes.
topics.reason: The phrase repeats the earlier recipient marker after the second disclosure verb.

words.gloss_range: completed divine pardon or effacement closing the conditional chain
words.root_gloss_range: root range of effacing traces, pardoning, and leaving unburdened surplus; locally completed divine pardon over the matter-chain
words.prose: {{ar:عَفَا}} ({{tr:ʿafā}}) breaks the conditional flow with a completed act of pardon. Its effacement root makes the closure stronger than a bare forgiveness note: the matter-chain is treated as settled, with room for both pardoning the inquiry and leaving the matters outside imposed burden. The clause also joins a legal-amnesty pattern, including the same-surah formula at 5:95 and the excessive-inquiry pardon pattern at 4:153.

topics.headline: completed pardon interrupts the conditionals
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that completed divine settlement interrupts possible disclosure and distress before the attribute seal.
topics.reason: The perfect verb enters without a connector after two jussive conditionals and pivots the ayah toward closure.

topics.headline: effacement, pardon, and non-legislation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices pardon as trace-effacement and unburdening, while the compressed object keeps the exact pardoned aspect broad rather than over-specified.
topics.reason: The root supports effacement and pardon, but the local construction with the pronoun leaves the object specification compressed.

topics.headline: same-surah legal amnesty pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pardon clause joining a legal-amnesty pattern, including the same-surah formula at 5:95 and the excessive-inquiry pardon pattern at 4:153.
topics.reason: The source rows link this pardon with divine agency, asking, covering, 5:95, and 4:153.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as explicit agent of the pardon
words.root_gloss_range: root range around deity, worship, and awe-commanding attachment; locally the proper divine name as explicit agent of pardon
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) is retained as the explicit subject of pardon. The grammar makes settlement a divine act rather than the natural fading of consequences, while derivational pressure around deity, worship, and awe colors the agent without turning the name into a generic category. Within Surah 5, this divine agency resolves a field where asking can be permitted in 5:4 but prohibited here.

topics.headline: named agent of pardon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that pardon is anchored in the named divine agent, not in human control or circumstance.
topics.reason: The proper divine name is the explicit subject of the pardon verb and recurs in the surah-local legal field.

topics.headline: worship and awe pressure around the name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices worship and awe pressure around the divine name, while local grammar keeps it as the proper subject of pardon.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is relevant as pressure but not as a replacement for the proper-name function.

topics.headline: asking contrast remains in the legal field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this pardon clause resolves a field where asking can be permitted in 5:4 but prohibited here.
topics.reason: The row supplies a same-surah contrast around asking that supports the legal authority frame.

words.gloss_range: final about-them phrase completing the referent chain and pardon construction
words.prose: {{ar:عَنْهَا}} ({{tr:ʿanhā}}) closes the pronoun chain by carrying the same matters into the pardon clause. The preposition also fits the regular pardon construction, marking the domain from which liability or consequence is lifted. The feminine-pronoun chain then points forward to the historical warning of 5:102.

topics.headline: same matters reach the pardon clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not switch objects; the same matters move from inquiry to disclosure to pardon.
topics.reason: The feminine suffix refers back to the earlier matters and confirms continuity across conditionals and pardon.

topics.headline: preposition completes pardon construction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the matters as the domain from which consequence is lifted.
topics.reason: The preposition forms the local pardon construction after the pardon verb.

topics.headline: pronoun chain points to next ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the feminine-pronoun chain continuing into the historical warning of 5:102.
topics.reason: The next ayah picks up the asking root with the same pronoun shape.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening the final attribute coda
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) restarts the sentence for the closing attributes. Rather than adding another event, it separates the completed pardon from the stable divine quality statement that explains the ending.

topics.headline: fresh attribute coda begins
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a shift from the specific act of pardon to a stable attribute declaration.
topics.reason: The conjunction is resumptive and opens a nominal clause after the pardon clause.

words.gloss_range: repeated proper divine name as nominal subject of the attribute coda
words.root_gloss_range: root range around deity, worship, and awe-commanding attachment; locally the repeated proper divine name as subject of the attribute coda
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) is repeated as the subject of a new nominal clause. The repetition prevents the closing attributes from feeling like a trailing modifier; they become a fresh assertion about the named divine subject, extending the specific pardon into a general attribute tail.

topics.headline: repeated name resets the closing clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from what God did to what God is.
topics.reason: The repeated proper name serves as subject of the final nominal clause and anchors both predicates.

topics.headline: attribute tail widens the pardon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the specific pardon becoming an instance of enduring divine covering and forbearance.
topics.reason: The derivational pressure and tadhyil-like tail frame the attributes as qualities of the worshiped, awe-commanding God.

words.gloss_range: intensive covering-forgiving attribute after exposure and effacement
words.root_gloss_range: root range of covering, concealing, protecting, and forgiving; locally an intensive standing attribute after disclosure and pardon
words.prose: {{ar:غَفُورٌ}} ({{tr:ghafūrun}}) turns covering-forgiveness into an enduring intensive quality, not a second event after pardon. After disclosure and effacement language, the covering root supplies a protective opposite to exposure, and its pairing with forbearance shifts the closure from the mercy pairing used at 5:98 toward deliberate restraint. That same covering attribute also fits Surah 5's pattern of resolving legal tension through divine covering.

topics.headline: habitual covering as standing quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices covering-forgiveness as a standing protective quality after harmful disclosure, not merely a one-time pardon.
topics.reason: The nominal predicate and intensive pattern present covering as enduring and abundant, while the root image answers exposure.

topics.headline: attribute pair marks restraint context
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing pair is context-specific: covering is joined to forbearance rather than the more common mercy pairing, fitting over-questioning.
topics.reason: The rows contrast the local pair with the common mercy formula and note the paired cadence.

topics.headline: same-surah legal closures use covering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the attribute as part of Surah 5’s pattern of resolving legal tension with divine covering.
topics.reason: Same-surah recurrence places the close within legal and pardon closures.

topics.headline: covering differs from effacement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices two forgiveness modalities: effacement removes traces, while covering protects what remains.
topics.reason: The ayah uses both the pardon verb and the covering attribute, preserving a layered closure.

words.gloss_range: qualitative forbearance as deliberate non-haste after warning and pardon
words.root_gloss_range: root range of forbearance, restraint, and dream-like suspension of immediate response; locally a qualitative divine attribute of deliberate non-haste
words.prose: {{ar:حَلِيمٌۭ}} ({{tr:ḥalīmun}}) completes the close with forbearance as an equal predicate beside covering-forgiveness. The form makes restraint a stable divine quality, and the root-family link to suspension or delayed reaction helps the reader feel why God does not hasten punishment over excessive questioning. The dream-sense contrast at 21:5 remains only suspension pressure; the local adjective selects divine forbearance.

topics.headline: forbearance equals forgiveness in the coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices forbearance as an equal closing attribute, not a minor gloss on forgiveness.
topics.reason: The adjective is a second nominative predicate and names deliberate non-reaction as a stable quality.

topics.headline: dream-restraint suspension pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shared idea of suspended response, while the local form selects divine forbearance rather than a dream sense.
topics.reason: The root-family pressure is real, including the 21:5 dream contrast, but the local adjective is the forbearance attribute.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَا تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ عَنْ أَشْيَآءَ إِن تُبْدَ لَكُمْ تَسُؤْكُمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: A question directs a request toward something that can be known and reported; disclosure then carries that object across a concealment boundary, and the resulting exposure causes distress. The prohibition therefore preserves a potentially protective opacity.

activation_trace.role: Question and request supply the initiating probe, repeated in both conditional frames.
A knowable, reportable thing supplies an answerable object rather than an impossibility.
Emergence after concealment supplies the transition that asking can trigger.
Distress and an unwelcome consequence supply the cost of disclosure.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely discourages questions whose answers will feel unpleasant.
changed_reading.after: The verse treats some concealment as protection: an answer can be available yet its disclosure still be harmful.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَإِن تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ عَنْهَا حِينَ يُنَزَّلُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ تُبْدَ لَكُمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: The temporal condition is causal rather than incidental. During active revelation, a question can receive an authoritative, publicly recited answer, so asking can move a latent matter into explicit revealed status.

activation_trace.role: The request is the human action whose consequence changes inside the revelatory interval.
The appointed time or occasion limits when asking becomes disclosure-producing.
Repeated delivery of revelation supplies the active channel through which an answer arrives.
Reading and recitation make the answer public and transmissible rather than private information.
Disclosure is the guaranteed result named for revelation-time asking.

changed_reading.before: The clause only identifies a bad moment for asking.
changed_reading.after: The revelatory moment makes asking performative: it can turn an unspecified matter into an authoritative disclosed answer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَنْهَا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: Pardon remains the direct reading, but the linked images of leaving something untouched, protective covering, and restraint also open a deliberately unexacted margin. The closing attributes make non-specification look like mercy rather than a defect in revelation.

activation_trace.role: Leaving punishment and effacing fault supplies the direct sense of divine pardon.
An untouched, untrampled remainder supplies the secondary image of a matter intentionally left alone.
Protective covering makes withheld exposure a form of preservation.
Forbearing restraint supplies the disposition that does not rush every latent matter into consequence.

changed_reading.before: God only forgives the improper act of asking.
changed_reading.after: The close may also protect a mercifully passed-over field: do not convert what was left unexacted into demanded specification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence forbids tightening what has been made permissible and distinguishes disregarded speech from an oath whose ends have been tied. Against that sequence, revelation-time questioning can occasion a comparable transition from an open matter to an articulated obligation with consequences.

activation_trace.role: The request supplies the act that can solicit specification.
Putting a matter in its proper revealed place supplies the authoritative articulation.
Prohibition supplies the narrowing operation that believers are told not to impose on permitted goods.
Release of a restriction supplies the permissive field that should not be needlessly tightened.
A discarded, non-counted utterance supplies the legally unbound side of the contrast.
Tying ends together supplies the image of speech becoming bound and consequential.

structural_cues: 5:87 and 5:101 share the believer address and a negative imperative.
5:89 contrasts disregarded speech with deliberately contracted speech and then details the latter's legal consequences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies permitted goods, self-prohibition, a discarded utterance, and a tied oath; I supply the analogy that a question during revelation can occasion legal tying. A live alternative is that these are neighboring but independent legal instructions.

changed_reading.before: Needless questions are discouraged because their answers may be personally upsetting.
changed_reading.after: Needless questions can narrow the permitted field by occasioning a binding articulation of what had remained open.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger's task is repeatedly bounded as delivery, once explicitly coupled with clarification. God, not the transmission channel, comprehends what people display and conceal. The focus command therefore disciplines demands that would force material beyond delivered clarification into public specification.

activation_trace.role: Questioning supplies the demand placed on the revelatory channel.
Delivered revelation supplies the channel's actual scope.
Conveying the message defines the messenger's assigned task.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign supplies the positive function of that delivery.
Repeated message-delivery language reasserts the bounded commission immediately before the focus.
What people make manifest supplies the displayed side of the reveal-conceal pair echoed in the focus.
Hiding and covering supply the concealed side known to God without requiring messenger-mediated exposure.

structural_cues: The phrase about clear delivery in 5:92 returns as delivery alone in 5:99.
5:99 places display and concealment immediately before 5:101 repeats the disclosure root twice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded delivery plus a display-conceal opposition; I infer that 5:101 protects the scope of delivered revelation from demands for surplus specification. A live alternative is that 5:99 concerns concealed human conduct rather than unlegislated matters.

changed_reading.before: The command suppresses the audience's desire to know.
changed_reading.after: The command regulates demands on a bounded revelatory office: receive delivered clarity without forcing every concealed matter into the message.

context_deltas.mechanism: A deliberately accessible thing tests conduct toward the unseen, and the resulting rule distinguishes what preceded and was pardoned from a return that attracts punishment. This sequence recasts harmful disclosure as crossing an accountability threshold: once a boundary is explicit, later conduct is no longer protected by prior non-specification.

activation_trace.role: A test that makes a person's condition appear supplies the disclosure-to-accountability mechanism.
A knowable thing becomes the concrete object through which the hidden posture is tested.
What is screened from sight supplies the prior hidden relation that conduct reveals.
Pardon and effacement protect the conduct that preceded the articulated boundary.
Temporal precedence marks the side of the threshold covered by pardon.
Return after departure supplies deliberate recurrence on the informed side of the threshold.
Punishment following recognized wrong supplies the heightened consequence of recurrence.
Covering fault and shielding its bearer keeps mercy active beside the severe consequence.

structural_cues: 5:94 calls the test object a thing and links it to an unseen posture.
5:95 places pardon for what preceded before punishment for returning, while 5:98 balances severe punishment with forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tested thing, hidden posture, pardon-before, and punishment-on-return; I supply the arrow that explicit revelation creates the liability threshold. Personal emotional distress remains a live, narrower alternative.

changed_reading.before: The disclosed answer may simply upset the questioner.
changed_reading.after: Disclosure may harm by making a formerly latent boundary actionable, so later violation becomes informed recurrence rather than a pardoned past.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent contrast says that abundance can attract and astonish without making bad material equal to good material. Applied to the plural objects of inquiry, this distinguishes answerability and novelty from benefit: a large supply of questions can be epistemically poor.

activation_trace.role: Questioning supplies the appetite-like pursuit being evaluated.
The soul's attraction toward an object supplies curiosity's pull toward more things.
Inferior material supplies the class whose abundance does not create value.
The good counterpart supplies the qualitative standard for selecting what is worth pursuing.
Wonder at the unfamiliar supplies the affect that can misrank an inquiry.
Numerical abundance supplies the misleading proxy for epistemic worth.

structural_cues: 5:100 immediately precedes the focus and contrasts quality with attractive abundance.
The focus uses an indefinite plural for the objects of asking rather than identifying one necessary question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attractive abundance that remains inferior; I apply that ranking to question selection. A live alternative is that 5:100 ranks moral goods only and does not directly classify inquiries.

changed_reading.before: Any answerable question is worth asking unless its answer is known to hurt.
changed_reading.after: Answerability, novelty, and quantity do not establish worth; the command disciplines an appetite for more disclosed objects.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate precedent repeats the act of asking and then marks a changed state of rejection. Asking is hazardous not because information itself is corrupting, but because the elicited matter can become an acknowledged object that the askers later disavow.

activation_trace.role: The repeated focus request establishes the act for which the next ayah supplies precedent.
Disclosure supplies the intervening event that makes a response to the matter possible.
A prior people's request supplies the direct historical analogue.
Becoming supplies an explicit transition from asking to a new stance.
Disavowal and withdrawal supply the resulting refusal of what had been elicited.

structural_cues: 5:102 immediately follows the focus and resumes its object with a pronoun.
The sequence grammatically places asking before becoming rejecters of those matters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies asking followed by a state of disavowal; I infer that disclosure creates the object or obligation later refused. The askers' prior disposition, rather than asking alone, remains a materially live cause.

changed_reading.before: The danger ends when an unwelcome answer is heard.
changed_reading.after: The deeper danger begins after hearing: a solicited answer can become the very commitment or sign that the asker then rejects.

context_deltas.mechanism: Question restraint is immediately flanked by two opposite epistemic failures: assigning divine status to categories God did not institute, and declaring inherited practice sufficient despite lack of knowledge. The command preserves revealed scope, neither forcing new specification nor licensing invented or inherited substitutes.

activation_trace.role: Questioning supplies one way of pressing beyond the presently delivered scope.
The untouched remainder supplies the space that must neither be forced open nor filled with invention.
Putting something into an assigned state supplies the divine institution explicitly denied for the named taboos.
Fabricating a lie supplies the unauthorized replacement for absent divine institution.
Falsehood against truth identifies the invented categories as epistemically invalid.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the missing control on fabrication.
Delivered revelation supplies the positive authority to which the audience is called.
Claimed sufficiency supplies the refusal to test inherited practice against revelation.
Failure of knowledge exposes inherited sufficiency as no warrant for quietism.

structural_cues: After the prior-question warning, 5:103 denies that God instituted a set of inherited taboo categories.
5:104 then opposes inherited sufficiency with a call to what God sent down and the messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied divine institution, fabricated categories, and inherited ignorance opposed to revelation; I infer a middle path of staying within revealed authorization. A live alternative is that these ayat target a specific idolatrous custom without defining inquiry more broadly.

changed_reading.before: Do not ask, so inherited silence or inherited rules are safer than investigation.
changed_reading.after: Do not force revelation beyond its scope, but do not fill that scope with fabricated taboos or unknowing ancestral sufficiency either.

context_deltas.mechanism: The testament procedure fixes a relevant time, requires knowledgeable testimony, forbids concealment, and provides correction if hidden guilt is discovered. Revelation itself therefore structures necessary disclosure where rights are at stake; the focus cannot be a blanket ban on consequential inquiry.

activation_trace.role: Questioning supplies the broader inquiry act whose permitted scope is being differentiated.
The appointed occasion supplies a controlled time for evidentiary action.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies the authorized form of disclosure.
Concealment is prohibited where it would suppress testimony owed to a right.
Coming upon what was hidden supplies warranted investigative discovery.
Establishing and displaying a right supplies the purpose that justifies corrective disclosure.

structural_cues: 5:106-108 gives a detailed sequence for testimony, suspicion, discovery, replacement, and correction.
The procedure uses the same timing root as the focus but directs disclosure toward preserving a concrete right.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies timed testimony, a ban on concealment, and correction after hidden guilt is found; I infer that rights-based, revelation-structured inquiry differs from curiosity-driven exposure. A live alternative is that testament procedure does not generalize beyond its legal setting.

changed_reading.before: Potentially painful facts should generally remain concealed.
changed_reading.after: Concealment is protective only where no overriding right requires disclosure; revelation can mandate a timed procedure for uncovering consequential facts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The disciples request a descent for food, heart-rest, knowledge, and witness. The request is granted as a sign, but rejection after that descent receives uniquely heightened punishment. This narratively enacts the focus mechanism: even a sincere reassurance-seeking request can increase liability once revelation makes its answer witnessed.

activation_trace.role: The focus request supplies the initiating act mirrored by the disciples' request.
Requested descent supplies the direct lexical and causal parallel to revelation-time asking.
Rest and reassurance supply a sincere motive for wanting the answer made tangible.
The heart supplies the inner site the requested sign is intended to settle.
Knowledge by disclosure supplies the epistemic gain explicitly sought.
Presence with observation turns the answer into a witnessed commitment.
A manifest sign supplies the public evidentiary status requested for the table.
Granted descent completes the transition from request to disclosed answer.
Covering or rejecting established truth supplies the prohibited response after disclosure.
Punitive pain supplies the exceptional liability attached to rejection after the sign descends.

structural_cues: 5:112-115 forms a request, motive, prayer, grant, and consequence sequence.
The descent root appears in the request and grant, echoing the focus clause about asking during descent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reassurance-seeking motives, requested and granted descent, witnessed sign, and heightened punishment; I identify that sequence as an enacted analogue of 5:101. A live alternative is that the table episode independently concerns a miracle demand rather than ordinary questions.

changed_reading.before: Only frivolous or hostile questions are dangerous.
changed_reading.after: Even a sincere request for reassurance can raise the stakes: once its answer descends as a witnessed sign, later rejection carries greater liability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant split mapping from س ء ل to س ل ل rather than the ordinary question branch. It remains anchored because that mapped inventory is explicitly supplied for both focus occurrences and coheres with disclosure and gathered recitation. Render it only as an exploratory material analogy, never as the lexical gloss of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ followed by repeated تُبْدَ لَكُمْ

activation_trace.role: Gently drawing a hidden object out of another supplies questioning as extraction rather than passive reception.
A chain joining one thing to another supplies the linked consequences created once the object is extracted.
Emergence after concealment supplies the extracted object's appearance.
Gathering parts together supplies incorporation of the extracted matter into a consequential public sequence.

changed_reading.before: A question neutrally requests information already waiting as an answer.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a question draws a latent matter from its sheath and links it into a chain of disclosed consequences.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus restrains human asking while 5:116 stages a divine interrogation despite explicit divine knowledge of inner and unseen matters. It remains valid as a functional contrast anchored in the focus's question-to-disclosure construction and the context's knowledge, testimony, and truth sequence. Render it as an analogy about questions making truth public, not as an equivalence between divine judgment and human curiosity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ ... تُبْدَ لَكُمْ as a question-to-manifestation construction

activation_trace.role: Questioning supplies the act being reconsidered as more than information acquisition.
Manifestation after concealment supplies the public effect a question can produce.
Voiced speech supplies the interrogative and answer staged for declaration.
Already disclosed knowledge to the knower shows that the interrogation is not filling an informational lack.
Comprehension of what is screened from sight removes discovery of the unknown as the question's purpose.
Presence with observation turns the elicited answer into testimony.
Truthful speech supplies the public criterion vindicated after the interrogation.

changed_reading.before: Questions function only to transfer unknown information to the asker.
changed_reading.after: A question can also be forensic and performative, making an already known truth answerable, witnessed, and public.

strongest_changes: Questions during active revelation are performative: they can turn a pardoned or open matter into articulated accountability.
The test and prior-question sequences recast harm as liability and possible rejection after a boundary is made known, not merely emotional discomfort.
The post-focus sequence blocks quietism: invented taboos and inherited ignorance are rejected, while rights-based disclosure is procedurally required.
The table request enacts the warning by turning a sincere request for reassurance into a witnessed sign with heightened consequences.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly paired openness with binding, display with concealment, pardon with return, asking with rejection, and descent with punishment. Its split س ء ل to س ل ل inventory also supported a contained image of questioning as extraction and chaining without displacing the ordinary lexical reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The referent and force of عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَنْهَا remain open: prior acts, questions, or matters; direct pardon or deliberately waived specification.
The حِينَ clause may warn that revelation-time questions inevitably receive answers, or it may preserve a narrower legitimate window for asking.
The legal procedures and table episode strongly sharpen the mechanism but may not delimit the focus ayah's original class of questions.
The س ء ل to س ل ل extraction model is explicitly packet-grounded but remains a form-distant analogy rather than a lexical claim.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Untimely inquiry can force harmful visibility.** `س ء ل B001` is requesting, `ب د و B001` visible emergence, `س و ء B002` harm, and `ح ي ن B001` due occasion. The question is not barred absolutely; asking during descent changes the condition. I infer that disclosure must be timed to revelation's live ordering rather than extracted as idle burden.
2. **Pardon and forbearance preserve productive silence.** `ع ف و B001` leaves punishment, `غ ف ر B001` covers, and `ح ل م B001` restrains with forbearance. I infer that what God has left unarticulated can function as merciful space rather than missing data.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A question can pull a latent matter into accountable visibility.** Repeated fixed **س ء ل / B001** (“asking and requesting”) is paired with repeated fixed **ب د و / B001** (“visible emergence”). The ayah makes timing decisive: asking during descent causes disclosure, while 5:102 shows earlier askers becoming rejecters and 5:103–5:104 show fabricated restrictions protected by inherited sufficiency. I infer that inquiry is performative when its answer creates a norm the asker must now carry. The warning reads against forcing burdensome emergence, not against learning as such.
2. **Forbearance leaves undisclosed space unforced.** Fixed **ح ل م / B001** (“restraint and forbearance”) follows pardon of what was left alone. I infer that divine restraint models why not every possible distinction must be made explicit. Silence here reads as merciful non-activation, not missing knowledge.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:102 provided the decisive warning: a fulfilled question can move from curiosity into rejection once its disclosed answer becomes binding.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiden bilgi edinmek için ona yönelmeyi ve bir şeyi ondan istemeyi aynı dalda açıkça tanımlar. Doğrudan nesne alan kullanım istek bildirmeye, bir konu ya da kişiyle kurulan ilgeçli kullanımlar ise bilgi edinmeye yönelir; çok soran kişi ve yardım isteyen yoksul için kullanılan adlar bu eylem çekirdeğine bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın eylem çekirdeğini korurken, doğrudan bir şeyi isteme ile bir konu veya kişi hakkında bilgi sorma kalıplarını ayrı uygulamalar olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye yönelerek ondan bir şey isteme ya da bir konu, nesne veya kişi hakkında bilgi edinmeye çalışma eylemidir. Doğrudan nesneli istek ve ilgeçli bilgi sorusu bu çekirdeğin farklı kuruluşlarıdır; çok soran veya yardım isteyen kişiye verilen adlar eylemden türeyen kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir muhataba yönelip bilgi edinmeye veya bir şeyi elde etmeye çalışma eylemini bildirir.
Bir şeyi doğrudan muhataptan isteme ile bir konu ya da kişi hakkında bilgi sorma, eylemin farklı söz dizimsel kuruluşlarıdır.
Çok soru soran kimse ve gereksinimini bildirerek yardım isteyen yoksul, eylemi yapan kişi olarak adlandırılabilir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه زئبر الثوب إذا ثار، والشعر أو الزغب على الساق أو الجبهة، والغفير الشعر السائل في القفا.
يدخل فيه رجوع المرض أو الجرح إلى حال أسوأ بعد تحسن، بصيغ غفر الجرح أو غفر المريض.
يدخل فيه الغفر ولد الأروية، والمغفر أو المغفرة أم ذلك الولد بحسب عبارات المصادر.
يدخل فيه الغفر بوصفه ثلاثة أنجم صغار من منازل القمر ومن الميزان.
يدخل فيه المغفور أو المغافير الخارجة من العرفط أو الرمث أو غيرهما، وما يشبه الصمغ أو يجتنى من الشجر.
يدخل فيه التعبير جماء الغفير أو جم الغفير عند مجيء القوم بجماعتهم وكثرتهم، الشريف والوضيع، بلا تخلف.

Kişinin dayanıklı oluşu, bu tutumu çabayla edinmesi veya yalnızca öyle görünmesi ve topluluğun sağduyulu kişileri ya da düşünme gücüyle ilgili kullanım bu çekirdeğe bağlı yan görünümlerdir.

facets.statement: Kişi aceleci taşkınlığa kapılmayıp öfkesinin yükselişini ve davranışını bilinçli biçimde dizginler.
Bu niteliği taşıyan kişi, kışkırtma karşısında dayanabilen ve ölçülü davranabilen biri olarak nitelenir.
Bir topluluğa bağlanan çoğul kullanım, topluluğun ağırbaşlı kişilerini veya bu tutumun sonucu sayılan düşünme gücünü gösterebilir.
Yapıya bağlı kullanımlarda kişi bu tutumu çabayla edinir ya da gerçekte taşımadığı halde taşıyormuş gibi görünür.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحلم خلاف الطيش، والصبر وكظم هيجان الغضب، ووصف الحليم، وأحلام القوم بمعنى حلمائهم أو عقولهم من جهة الأثر.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الحلم خلاف الطيش (maqayis)؛ الحلم الأناة، وأحلام القوم حلماؤهم، والحليم في صفة الله تعالى معناه الصبور (ayn;tahdhib)؛ الحلم بالكسر الأناة، وتحلم تكلف الحلم، وتحالم أرى من نفسه ذلك وليس به (sihah)؛ الحلم ضبط النفس والطبع عن هيجان الغضب، وليس الحلم في الحقيقة هو العقل (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما يراه النائم، وحلم واحتلم، وتكلف دعوى حلم لم يره، وحلم خيال شخص في النوم.
يدخل فيه زمان البلوغ، وكل حالم أو محتلم بمعنى البالغ، سواء وقع الاحتلام أم لم يقع.
يدخل فيه حلم الأديم أو الإهاب إذا تثقب وفسد، وفساد جلد الحيوان أو البعير أو العناق بكثرة الحلم فيه.
يدخل فيه الحلم أو الحلمة من القراد، والحلمة الدويبة، وحلمة الثدي أو ثندوة الرجل المشبهة بها في الهيئة.
يدخل فيه تحلم الصبي أو الضب إذا سمن واكتنز، والبعير الحليم أو الحلم بمعنى السمين، والأحلام بمعنى الأجسام.
يدخل فيه الحلمة اسما لنبت أو شجرة مرعى، مع اختلاف المصدر في صلتها بالسعدان أو الحماطة.
يدخل فيه حلمت البعير أو الإبل إذا أخذت عنها الحلم، ويشمل الاستعمال المجازي حلمت فلانا إذا داريته ليسكن.
يدخل فيه محلم نهرا أو عينا أو اسم رجل، ويوم حليمة، وحليمات موضعا.
يدخل فيه الحلام للجدي أو صغار الغنم، والحالوم للبن يغلظ كأنه جبن رطب، مع بقاء الإشكال في أصلهما.

tier_contracts.local_low_branch_safety: branch_ref, payload_tier, branch_image_ar, what_is_ar, status, branch_kind, and reviewed/dictionary concept/context gloss text.
tier_contracts.compact_rest: branch_ref, payload_tier, branch_image_ar, what_is_ar, status; a semantic fallback is added only when both Arabic fields are empty.

branch_policy.compact_gloss_policy: Reviewed gloss branches remain as branch_ref/payload_tier stubs; their branch records are trimmed, not filtered out.
branch_policy.note: Every root target and dictionary branch identity is retained. Branch payload detail is tiered from generation-time citations; non-full branches and reviewed gloss records are trimmed, not absent. Root lexicon and branch inventory availability never create interest.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
